A.	About Tencent
       Tencent is a leading global technology and entertainment company focused on connecting people and developing innovative products and services. Founded in 1998 and publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2004, Tencent’s communication and social services, entertainment (video games, music, sports, and film/TV), fintech, cloud, and enterprise solutions are used by hundreds of millions of people around the world.

To learn more about the company, visit www.Tencent.com (About Us).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Most importantly, they should possess strong analytical instincts, sound judgment, and a desire to help shape the future of AI policy in a rapidly changing global environment.

0 – 3 years of relevant professional experience.
Strong interest in artificial intelligence, technology policy, innovation, and emerging technologies.

Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.

Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.
Document reusable AI use cases, asset pipeline standards, rigging and physics best practices, performance guidelines and evaluation methods. Share knowledge through workshops, technical reviews and project retrospectives.
Monitor trends in generative AI, neural rendering, procedural content generation, machine learning for deformation and physics, digital humans and real-time graphics, assessing their practical value for AAA asset and animation production.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Graphics, Digital Media, Game Development, Art and Design, Animation, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
At least 8 years of professional experience in technical art, animation technology or a closely related discipline, with significant exposure to AAA asset and animation pipelines.
Experience operating as a Senior Technical Artist, Lead Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, Animation Pipeline Lead, Rigging Lead or equivalent senior role with a clear focus on assets and/or animation.
Proven development experience on a recognised AAA game project, including at least one shipped AAA title where you were directly responsible for asset optimisation, rigging, or physics-animation workflows.
Strong understanding of the complete AAA asset and animation lifecycle, from initial modelling and rigging, through version control and validation, to engine integration, performance profiling and runtime optimisation.
Strong interest in generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, especially as applied to asset generation, asset optimisation, auto-rigging, motion synthesis, deformation prediction and physics simulation.
Ability to identify high-value AI opportunities rooted in real asset and animation production challenges and progress them through proof-of-concept, workflow design, tool integration and production adoption.
Strong experience with Unreal Engine or another major game engine, including real-time rendering, asset management, animation blueprints, physics assets and cross-platform performance constraints.
Proficiency in Blender or Maya; working knowledge of Houdini is a plus.
Experience with tools development or workflow automation using Python, C++, Blueprint or equivalent, particularly for asset processing, rigging automation or physics pipeline tools.
Strong problem-solving, solution design and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance asset quality, animation expressiveness, engineering feasibility and production efficiency.
Excellent English communication skills, able to lead technical discussions, conduct solution reviews, prepare documentation and collaborate effectively in an international environment.
Willingness to work across regions and time zones and to travel to partner studios in Europe or other locations when required.

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:
​​(1) AAA asset production pipelines (characters, environments, props) with a strong emphasis on performance optimisation, memory budgets, LOD strategies and visual consistency.
(2) Asset visual quality and efficiency: material authoring, texture optimisation, shading models, draw call management and cross-platform asset validation.
(3) Skeleton design and character/creature rigging: hierarchical structures, joint placement, modular rig systems, and auto-rigging methods.
(4) Skinning and deformation: linear blend skinning, dual quaternion skinning, corrective blendshapes, muscle systems and deformation quality control.
(5) Physics-based animation: cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics, ragdoll setups, secondary motion, and real-time physics constraints in engine.

title: Tencent Cloud- Senior Strategic Sales Executive (Gen AI & Cloud) – Singapore
title_raw: Tencent Cloud- Senior Strategic Sales Executive (Gen AI & Cloud) – Singapore
responsibilities:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Identify, prospect, and develop strategic enterprise opportunities for Tencent Cloud’s AI and cloud solutions within the Singapore and SouthEast Asian market.
Build and manage executive-level relationships with customers, AI native companies, digital-native companies, ISVs, and enterprise organizations adopting Generative AI technologies.
Drive the sales of AI infrastructure, large language model (LLM) services, AI platforms, Model-as-a-Service (MaaS), API/token-based AI services, cloud infrastructure, and related SaaS offerings.
Lead the entire enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and solution positioning to commercial negotiations, contract execution, and successful deal closure.
Partner closely with Solution Architects, AI specialists, Product teams, and Business Contracts Managers to design customer-centric AI and cloud solutions.
Develop strategic account plans, pipeline forecasts, territory plans, and executive business reviews to consistently exceed revenue targets.
Understand customers’ AI transformation initiatives and recommend appropriate Tencent Cloud AI capabilities, including LLMs APIs, model hosting, AI agents, AI tools and AI development platforms.
Analyze industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging AI use cases to identify new business opportunities and develop go-to-market strategies.
Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams to maximize customer success, expansion opportunities, and long-term account growth.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of enterprise technology sales experience, with at least 2 years selling AI products, Generative AI platforms, LLM APIs, AI infrastructure, cloud services, GPU computing, ML platforms, SaaS, or developer platforms.
Demonstrated experience selling AI solutions such as LLM APIs, token-based AI services, inference platforms, AI agents, MLOps platforms, AI developer tools, or cloud AI infrastructure is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of the AI ecosystem, including Large Language Models (LLMs), foundation models, prompt engineering, AI inference, embeddings, AI agents, API consumption, and token-based commercial models.
Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers (“hunter” mindset) while expanding strategic accounts and consistently exceeding sales targets.
Experience engaging C-level executives, technology leaders, AI teams, and business decision-makers, with a history of closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.
Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to translate complex AI and cloud technologies into measurable business outcomes.
Experience working with AI startups, digital-native companies, ISVs, SaaS vendors, or enterprise AI transformation projects is a strong advantage.
Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese is preferred to effectively collaborate with internal teams and regional stakeholders.
Excellent analytical, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky

title: 高性能计算工程师
title_raw: 高性能计算工程师
responsibilities:
1.超大规模LLM性能工程： 主导并规划千亿参数级大模型的极致性能优化技术路线。负责 PagedAttention、连续批处理等核心调度策略的深度定制与生产级架构设计，负责 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 等主流推理框架的内核级优化与落地；
2.低比特与稀疏模型优化： 牵头 INT4/FP8/AWQ 等前沿低比特量化技术的工业级系统化落地，平衡精度与计算效率。并设计面向 MoE 模型的分布式调度、路由、显存管理及跨卡通信的优化方案；
3.统一与多模态架构： 定义并设计一套具备长期扩展性的统一 AI 推理引擎架构，以支撑自回归生成任务，并前瞻性地解决多模态大模型（如视觉-语言模型）的协同推理部署挑战；
4.异构算力与国产化适配： 主导推理引擎在国产AI芯片（如昇腾、海光、天数等）平台上的战略级移植、生态适配与性能优化。对 HCCL/NCCL 等通信原语进行深度优化和定制，实现跨异构架构的算力自主可控；
5.核心算子优化与指令架构创新 (Enhanced Focus):深度介入 GPU/NPU 硬件底层，主导设计和实现LLM特有高性能算子。 重点包括：高性能Attention Kernel、矩阵乘法（GEMM）的深度定制与融合、KV Cache读写优化等关键算子；
6.具备深入理解和利用硬件指令集架构（ISA）和微架构（Microarchitecture）的能力， 通过 CUDA/Triton 或国产芯片底层编程语言，进行SIMD/SIMT指令优化、指令级并行（ILP）及寄存器重用等，将LLM推理性能推向硬件理论极限。
